jobs.title: Supervising Social Worker
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Organic Fostering, we take pride in being the sole fostering agency dedicated to cultural and heritage matching. Based in Manchester, we support vulnerable children throughout Greater Manchester. We regard our carers as professionals, offering them 24/7 support and guidance from our team of specialists. Our management team brings over 50 years of diverse social work experience and expertise.

Role Description

This is a part-time hybrid role for a Supervising Social Worker located in the Manchester Area, United Kingdom. Some work-from-home is acceptable. The Supervising Social Worker will be responsible for overseeing and supporting foster care placements, conducting home visits, assessing foster families, providing ongoing training, and ensuring compliance with regulations and standards. The role also involves preparing reports and documentation, liaising with other professionals and agencies, and participating in team meetings.

Qualifications

Experience in social work, specifically in foster care or similar fields
Strong assessment and reviewing skills
Ability to provide training and support to foster families
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Proficiency in administrative tasks, including report writing
Social Work degree and registration with the appropriate professional body
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Knowledge of regulations and standards in foster care
Experience in working with children and young people is a plus

jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Cedarbrook Senior Living, we work hard every day to find out what “Celebrating Life Every Day!” means to our residents and their families, then we help them achieve these goals. We are seeking a dynamic Training Coordinator for our community.

Responsibilities

Assists residents with their personal care which includes grooming, hygiene, dressing, nutrition, etc.
Responds to pendant pushes to determine resident's needs and conducts routine rounds on residents to verify safety.
Listens to and understands the problems of residents and reports observations immediately to Supervisor, if appropriate.
Works as a Caregiver, CNA, or Med Tech as scheduled.
Assists the Director of Staff Development with orienting Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Nursing Home staff to policies and procedures before being released from New Employee Orientation.
Fosters a high degree of quality care by assisting the Director of Staff Development with coaching and counseling Caregivers, CNAs, and Med Techs.
Nurtures, supports, guides, and offers resources to new and current team members through training.
Provides feedback regarding the training and mentoring process for new and current team members to the Director of Staff Development.
Completes competency skills required for floor training checkoffs with new hire CNAs, Caregivers, and Med Techs to ensure goals and objectives are met.
Perform assessments for Med Tech Medication Pass Observation Check and Competency Evaluation.
Conducts assessments for CNA and Caregiver Competency Evaluation.
Observes and reports observations such as resident change of condition, incidents, injuries, skin concerns.
Reports when team member’s competencies do not meet policy, procedures, and Health and Safety regulations by offering on the job training and corrective action as needed to retain positive outcomes for residents and staff.
Collaborates with the Director of Staff Development with monitoring training activities, verifying progress and outcomes.
Conducts training and orientation for new hire care staff during the absence of the Director of Staff Development.

Education/Experience

Certified Nurse Assistant Certification in good standing, preferred.
Med Tech training course completion though MCAL required within 90 days of hire.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, Earned Sick Time, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, 401(k) Retirement Savings plan, etc.

jobs.title: Veterinary Receptionist (Care Coordinator) - Veterinary Healthcare Center
jobs.description:
PetVet Care Centers' Veterinary Healthcare Center
is currently seeking a Veterinary Receptionist (Care Coordinator)
to join our team!

At PetVet Care Centers, our mission is to improve the lives of animals and people — providing exceptional and compassionate care at every stage — for all the moments that matter.

Because life is better with pets.

We deliver the Ultimate Care Experience — every pet, every client, every time.
That starts with a Culture of Care that supports our team members as much as the pets and clients we serve.

With more than 420 locally led hospitals
and over 11,000 team members nationwide
, we offer:

Local autonomy with national support
Career mobility and development opportunities
A collaborative, inclusive environment where your wellbeing comes first

You care for pets. We care for you.

Position Overview

Join our team as a Care Coordinator
who contributes to the success of a high-performing organization committed to delivering superior care and exceptional service. Performs a range of administrative and customer service tasks, providing valuable support to the hospital. Within the veterinary field, this position aligns closely with roles often titled Veterinary Receptionist, Customer Service Representative, or Client Care Specialist.

Veterinary Healthcare Center
IN Monterey Park, California provides a wide range of services with a strong focus on quality care and client education. Our team fosters a supportive culture centered on growth and teamwork.

Why Join Us:

Join an AAHA-accredited hospital with a team of 6 full-time DVMs, a collaborative environment, and a commitment to modernizing our practice through a transition to a paperless system.

Key Responsibilities

Provides excellent customer service in-person, over the phone, and during high-stress situations.
Manages lobby flow, addresses concerns, calms distressed owners, and schedules appointments.
Handles basic medical emergencies for pets and owners, ensuring safety and well-being.
Assists with medication pickups, inquiries, and provides information about services and products.
Inputs and manages data in practice management software, including billing and accounts.
Assists with retail sales, weighing pets, processing faxes, and maintaining records.
Reconciles cash drawer and performs end-of-day duties for accurate financial transactions.

Qualifications (Required)

Applicants must be 18 years of age or older to be considered for this position
High school diploma or GED required, or equivalent combination of education, certification, training, and/or experience
1 year receptionist experience

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

Cornerstone knowledge
Veterinary knowledge
Spanish speaking

Schedule
: Full Time, Swing shift

Monday 10AM-7PM or 1PM-10PM
Tuesday 10AM-7PM or 1PM-10PM
Wednesday 9AM-6PM or 10AM-7PM
Thursday 10AM-7PM or 1PM-10PM
Friday 9AM-6PM
Saturday 9AM-6PM
Schedule is flexible

What We Offer

We care deeply about supporting our team members — professionally and personally. Benefits include:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Paid Parental Leave (birth, adoption, foster)
401(k) with discretionary contribution
Team Member Pet Discounts
Emotional wellbeing support — including Calm app access and 24/7 EAP
CE stipends and career development resources
Grant Circle — a relief fund for team members facing personal hardship
Local hospital culture backed by national resources

Pay Range

$17—$20 USD

At PetVet Care Centers, we're committed to a Culture of Care
— for pets, for the people who love them, and for the team members who make it all possible. With more than 400 hospitals across the U.S.
and a team of over 11,000 dedicated professionals
, including 1700+ veterinarians
, we offer a unique blend of local leadership and national support that helps our hospitals thrive.

Our model is built on partnership, collaboration, and local medical autonomy
, empowering each hospital to deliver high-quality care while benefiting from shared resources and a strong professional community. Whether you're providing care in a hospital or supporting operations behind the scenes, PetVet is a place where you can grow your career, stay connected to your purpose, and make a meaningful impact.

You care for pets. We care for you.

PetVet is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, religion, citizenship, national origin/ancestry, physical/mental disabilities, military status or any other basis prohibited by law. EOE, M/F/D/V
